plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp build for boxing with strength and power as the main priorities while keeping some speed work in place. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main percentage-based lifts, one lift per session, so the main loading work can start in Week 2. Weeks 2-3 build clean technique, force production, and simple explosive work that fits a beginner well. Week 4 is a deload with lower volume so you recover, keep moving well, and set up the next block.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish training maxes, build sound lifting skill, and raise general strength and power with beginner-friendly exercise choices.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and keep explosive work crisp while trimming any volume that clashes with boxing load.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Convert the earlier strength gains into faster, sharper sport-relevant power and speed without forcing a full speed peak.
